name: Webly Supervised Multi-Label Recognition Benchmark
description: Evaluates multi-label image recognition performance under webly supervised (noisy web) training conditions.
evaluation_method: mAP (mean Average Precision) and per-class F1 / overall F1
reputation: A specialized benchmark for studying multi-label recognition under noisy web supervision; cited in research on webly-supervised learning but not a mainstream benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM computer vision benchmark that explicitly studies noisy web labels (webly supervision). Results can be sensitive to noise-handling strategies; possible label noise and dataset-specific biases limit direct comparability to fully supervised benchmarks.
